newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian leading indicator improves in February.
newsitem.headline: Belgian leading indicator improves in February.

text.p: The Belgian central bank released the following indices based on its monthly survey of three key economic sectors -
In a statement, the Central Bank said the improvement in the headline figure in February was a result of divergent factors.
It noted that industry had stabilised, business had fallen and there had been a strong increase in construction.
This latter, it said, was largely due to the drastic improvement in weather conditions in February from January.
